name: ISM Manufacturing PMI (Aug)
note: Prices Paid held 71.1. Softer headline, still expansion.

name: FOMC Rate Decision
note: 10-2 vote. Cook and Hammack dissented for 25bp hike. Economy 'strong'; inflation elevated. Dec hike odds ~85-86%.

name: GDP Q3 (advance)
note: BEA official. Investment + consumer + govt; exports down, imports up. Real final sales to private domestic +4.9%. Core PCE Q3 +2.5%.

name: Initial Jobless Claims
note: DOL week ending Oct 24. 4-wk avg 196.75k. Continuing 1.701M. Soft, labor still tight.

name: PCE / Personal Income (Sep)
note: BEA official. Headline PCE hotter m/m. Keeps Dec hike live (~81-82% post-FOMC).

name: Employment Cost Index (Q3)
note: BLS official. Wages +0.7%, benefits +0.9%. In-line, not inflationary. Dec hike odds ~68-73%.
